title: Letter
summary: Start: enter Letter. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the interceptor sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. Letters of marque expire here more often than they are honored. The law is red. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Marque Rock's shell. Red Keel heat rises. The letter is still expired. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
